You can attune yourself to the item the instant you infuse it, or you can forgo attunement so that someone else can attune to the item. Your infusion remains in an item indefinitely, but when you die, the infusion vanishes after 3 days. The infusion also vanishes if you give up your knowledge of the infusion or you exceed your maximum number of infusions. [2 / Other • 1 Action]
